title: Same Name, Different Server: A Security Census of Silent Drift in the Model Context Protocol Ecosystem
abstract: arXiv:2609.14119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has become the common interface through which large language model applications reach external tools, and its public registry now distributes thousands of community-built servers with little of the vetting infrastructure that mature package ecosystems have accumulated. This paper reports a census of that ecosystem. We harvested the full public MCP registry (21,643 servers, 72,606 version records, August 2026 snapshot), fetched source code for 14,353 servers, and applied a pattern-based scanner covering an eight-class threat catalogue whose accuracy we measured against 414 hand-labeled findings. Observed prevalence is dominated by unauthenticated network exposure (9.57% of scanned servers); after correcting each class by its measured precision, 11.14% observed high-severity prevalence reduces to roughly 7.6%. The central finding concerns instability rather than any single weakness: 51.1% of multi-version

translated_title: 同名异服：模型上下文协议生态系统中静默漂移的安全普查
translated_abstract: 模型上下文协议（MCP）已成为大语言模型应用连接外部工具的通用接口，其公共注册表现在分发着数千个由社区构建的服务器，但缺乏成熟软件包生态系统所积累的审查基础设施。本文报告了对该生态系统的一次普查。我们采集了完整的公共MCP注册表（2026年8月快照，含21,643个服务器、72,606条版本记录），获取了14,353个服务器的源代码，并应用了一个覆盖八类威胁目录的基于模式的扫描器，其准确性通过414个手工标注的发现进行了测量验证。观察到的流行率以未认证的网络暴露为主（占扫描服务器的9.57%）；在根据实测精确度对每类进行校正后，11.14%的观察到的高危流行率降低至约7.6%。核心发现关乎不稳定性而非任何单一弱点：51.1%的多版本……
tldr: 该论文对MCP生态系统进行了大规模安全普查，发现约7.6%的服务器存在高危安全问题，且超过半数的多版本服务器存在“静默漂移”现象——同名服务器在不同版本间可能指向不同的实际服务，构成严重的供应链安全风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a large-scale security census of the MCP ecosystem, finding that roughly 7.6% of servers harbor high-severity issues and that over half of multi-version servers exhibit "silent drift," where the same name may resolve to different underlying servers across versions, posing serious supply-chain security risks.
